content.text: Section 8 is a one-way Vendor indemnity in our favour, and Section 9 carves indemnity liability out of the cap entirely. No redline warranted.

input.quote: 8.1 By Commerce One. Commerce One shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless Corio and its Customers from any and all damages, liabilities, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees) incurred by Corio or its Customers arising out of any claim that the Software infringes any patent, copyright, trademark or trade right secret of a third party; provided that Corio or its Customer promptly notifies Commerce One in writing of any such claim and promptly tenders the control and the defense and settlement of any such claim to Commerce One at Commerce One's expense and with Commerce One's choice of counsel.
input.rationale: Section 8.1 is a one-way Vendor (Commerce One) indemnity running to us and our Customers, covering third-party claims that the Software infringes patent, copyright, trademark or trade secret rights, with defence and settlement at Vendor's cost, standard notice/tender/cooperation procedure, and the usual remedy ladder (procure rights, replace or modify, or terminate and refund a pro-rated portion of fees paid). The exclusions in Section 8.2 are limited to use outside the Documentation and third-party modification — narrower than the customary carve-outs, and there is no combination exclusion. Critically, Section 9 excepts "LIABILITY ARISING UNDER SECTION 8" from both the 12-month fee cap and the consequential-damages waiver, so the indemnity is uncapped rather than merely subject to a 3x super-cap. There is no reciprocal Corio indemnity anywhere in the Agreement (searches for "indemnif", "hold harmless" and "defend" return only Section 8), so nothing needs narrowing on our side. This exceeds the fallback and substantially meets the preferred position. Noted but not flagged as deviations: the indemnity does not add express limbs for Vendor's breach of applicable law, unauthorised access to Customer Data, or gross negligence/wilful misconduct, and affiliates are not named (though "Corio and its Customers" is broader in the relevant respect). These are sub-elements short of the preferred wording and do not warrant a redline given the indemnity is uncapped and one-way in our favour.
